title: The Hostile File
prompt: Implement kv_load with full validation: magic, version, exact length (short read → KV_ETRUNC), checksum before touching the table (mismatch → KV_EBADSUM). Load must RESET the destination store first.

tests.name: round-trip state
tests.hint: Load is 'become the state in this file', not 'merge'.

tests.name: each corruption has its own verdict
tests.hint: A loader that says 'corrupt' for everything is as useless as one that says 'fine'.
